snippet.title: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
A mysterious haunting plagues the gated subdivision of Myrtle Grove. It's up to Paranormal Investigator Clair V. to discover the roots of the tragedy that keeps the spirit around. This top down 2.5D narrative game will take you through the brief but rich story of a Louisiana inspired neighborhood. Using Spirit Vision, Clair leaves their body in an astral form to explore the history of the place and dig deeper into the truth of the festering catalyst of its haunting.

Wishlisht on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141000/Myrtle_Grove_A_Clair_V_Mystery/
